name: slider
title: Slider
description: A slider that feels native on iPhone and Android: thumb and fill ride the native driver, the thumb swells under your finger, tap the track to seek, and values spring-snap to the step. Thin iOS track, a Control-Center style bar with an icon that inverts as the fill passes, a stepped track with ticks, and two-thumb range mode with an optional histogram.
summary: A native-driver slider with a swelling thumb, tap-to-seek and a two-thumb range mode.
behavior: Tap anywhere on the track to seek, or grab a thumb and drag. Built-in leftIcon and rightIcon names step the value down or up when tapped.
Thumb and fill move on the native driver; the thumb swells under your finger and values spring-snap to the step.
Single mode is one adjustable element with min, max, current value and increment / decrement actions. In range mode each thumb is its own adjustable, labelled 'minimum' and 'maximum'.
props: Controlled or uncontrolled. A number, or [from, to] when range is set (typed by the range prop).
Fires when the stepped value changes (drag, tap, icon or accessibility action).
Bounds and snap interval (0 = continuous). Coarse steps spring between positions; fine ones follow the finger and snap on release.
Two thumbs selecting a span; value becomes [from, to].
Thin track + round thumb, a tall Control-Center bar with no thumb, or a track with a tick at every step.
Scales track, thumb, bar height and text. Hit area is always ≥ 44pt.
Ticks at every step, or custom values with labels under the track.
Value tooltip above the thumb. On a bar, "always" shows the value inside the bar instead.
Text for the tooltip, labels and accessibility value.
Labels under both ends of the track (formatted min / max by default).
Bar only: icon inside the bar that changes colour as the fill passes over it.
Icon beside the track. Built-ins ('volume-low', 'volume-high', 'volume-off', 'sun-low', 'sun-high', 'minus', 'plus') step the value when tapped.
Default variant: draws the fill thicker than the track.
Bars above the track; bars inside the selection use the accent.
Announced with the adjustable role; range thumbs get “minimum” / “maximum”.
Root, inactive track, active fill, thumb and value text.
